explanation: The prophet and leader of the people of Israel who received the law from God and led them out of Egypt and through the wilderness.
The divine instructions and commandments given by God to Moses on Mount Sinai, including the Ten Commandments.
The land and blessings that God promised to give to the people of Israel, especially Canaan, the promised land.
An action, thought, or attitude that breaks God's will and moral law, leading to separation from God.
An attitude of modesty and submission, where one acknowledges their own limitations and dependence on God.
